samples: This program implements a role-based access control system that checks whether a combination of user roles grants all permissions required for an action. It provides functions to compute the union of permissions across roles, identify missing permissions, verify if an action is allowed, and find permissions shared between two roles. The included demo checks whether a viewer and editor together can publish posts, reports any missing permissions, and lists permissions they both share.
